integrity: The pointwise identities follow from complete signed-vertex optimization of convex chord means; all minimizing sets and both sharp stability laws follow algebraically. The included exact-rational checker independently replays finite examples and equality witnesses. A source describing the planar 3/2 bound cannot be applied outside dimension two. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional real l1/l-infinity dual pairs only; no universal upper bound on duality gaps among arbitrary Banach spaces. Original defining 2000 article was not available in full and remains an originality risk.
title: Exact Minkowski-ellipse duality gap and sharp minimizer stability in the cube–crosspolytope pair
